## Test SNP simulation

```{r}
J <- 3
K <- 10
N <- 300
M <- 600
cocktail <- snp_simulation(J = J, K = K, N = N, M = M, seed = 1)

# Some checks
class(cocktail)
names(cocktail)
str(cocktail$data)
str(cocktail$params)
str(cocktail$seed)
```

## Test Add Trait

```{r}
cocktail <- add_trait(cocktail, beta0 = 10)

# Some checks
str(cocktail$covariance)
str(cocktail$summary)
str(cocktail$component)
str(cocktail$params)
str(cocktail$data)

# Check scale
cocktail <- add_trait(cocktail, beta0 = 10, scale = TRUE)
cocktail$summary$sample_var_composition

# Check V_Noise
R <- matrix(0.5, nrow = N, ncol = N)
diag(R) <- 1
cocktail <- add_trait(cocktail, beta0 = 10, R = R)
try(
  cocktail <- add_trait(cocktail, beta0 = 10, R = "bad_specification"), 
)
try(
  cocktail <- add_trait(cocktail, beta0 = 10, R = matrix(0)), 
)
try(
  cocktail <- add_trait(cocktail, beta0 = 10, R = data.frame()), 
)
```

## Test Add Additive

```{r}
cocktail <- add_additive(cocktail, r = 1)
cocktail$summary$sample_var_composition

# Some checks
str(cocktail$summary)
str(cocktail$params)
str(cocktail$component)
str(cocktail$effects)

# Check coverage
cocktail <- add_additive(cocktail, r = 2)
cocktail$summary$sample_var_composition

# Check scale
cocktail <- add_additive(cocktail, r = 1, scale = TRUE)
cocktail$summary$sample_var_composition
```

## Test Add Polygenic

```{r}
# Check genotype standardization
str(feature_map$vanraden()(cocktail))

# Add effects
cocktail <- add_polygenic(cocktail, r = 1)
cocktail$summary$sample_var_composition

# Some checks
str(cocktail$summary)
str(cocktail$params)
str(cocktail$component)
str(cocktail$effects)

# Check coverage
cocktail <- add_polygenic(cocktail, r = 2)
cocktail$summary$sample_var_composition

# Check scale
cocktail <- add_polygenic(cocktail, r = 1, scale = TRUE)
cocktail$summary$sample_var_composition
```

## Test ESS

```{r}
# Per-marker ESS (reliability ratio)
ess(cocktail, m = 1:10) 

# Contrast-specific ESS
ess(cocktail, x = rep(1,M))

# Check subset
ess(cocktail, m = 1:10, S = 1:10)
```

## Test Generics

```{r}
cocktail
str(dimnames(cocktail))
dim(cocktail)
str(genotype(cocktail))
str(metadata(cocktail))
```

## The Pipeline

```{r}
devtools::document()
J <- 3
K <- 10
N <- 300
M <- 600
cocktail <- snp_simulation(J = J, K = 10, N = N, M = M, seed = 1) %>%
            add_trait(beta0 = 10) %>%
            add_additive(r = 1) %>%
            add_polygenic(r = 1)  
cocktail
```
